test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The questions were framed by the content creators just to assess the skills of the test takers.

options.text: The content creators framed the questions just to assess the skills of the test takers.
The content creators could frame the questions just to assess the skills of the test takers
The content creators were framing the questions just to assess the skills of the test takers.
The content creators had framed the questions just to assess the skills of the test takers.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The questions were framed by the content creators just to assess the skills of the test takers."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "the content creators" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "were framed" to "framed" (past simple active).
 
• Ensure the object "the questions" follows the verb for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The content creators framed the questions just to assess the skills of the test takers."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"The content creators could frame the questions just to assess the skills of the test takers." – Incorrect because it changes the meaning by using "could" instead of past tense.
 
• **Option 3: **"The content creators were framing the questions just to assess the skills of the test takers." – Incorrect tense (past continuous).
 
• **Option 4: **"The content creators had framed the questions just to assess the skills of the test takers." – Incorrect tense (past perfect).
